    -53941,  # 1945

    -3117,   # 1954

    -2819,   # 1958
    -12427   # 1959
]

print(f"Sum: {sum(data)}")
print(f"Mean: {statistics.mean(data):.3f}")

# Sample standard deviation (n-1 denominator)
sample_std = statistics.stdev(data)

print(f"\nManual calculation: {manual_std:.3f}")
